_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "contact" TEXT NULL, "external_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sites" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "outline" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "agreed_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "report_sent_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pictures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "file_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NULL, "after_of" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "subject_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NULL, "audio_sha256" TEXT NULL, "audio_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "audio_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "transcript" TEXT NULL, "transcript_source" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NULL, "fixture_id" TEXT NULL, "level" INTEGER NULL, "compartment" INTEGER NULL, "floor_x_cm" INTEGER NULL, "floor_y_cm" INTEGER NULL, "target_site_id" TEXT NULL, "target_room_id" TEXT NULL, "target_fixture_id" TEXT NULL, "target_level" INTEGER NULL, "target_compartment" INTEGER NULL, "target_floor_x_cm" INTEGER NULL, "target_floor_y_cm" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "place_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_site_id" TEXT NULL, "from_room_id" TEXT NULL, "from_fixture_id" TEXT NULL, "from_level" INTEGER NULL, "from_compartment" INTEGER NULL, "from_floor_x_cm" INTEGER NULL, "from_floor_y_cm" INTEGER NULL, "to_site_id" TEXT NULL, "to_room_id" TEXT NULL, "to_fixture_id" TEXT NULL, "to_level" INTEGER NULL, "to_compartment" INTEGER NULL, "to_floor_x_cm" INTEGER NULL, "to_floor_y_cm" INTEGER NULL, "moved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "moved_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_keys" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_properties" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_text" TEXT NULL, "value_number" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "change_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'upsert' CHECK("op" IN ('upsert', 'delete', 'restore', 'move_entry')), "fields" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NULL, "device_time" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workspace_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "server_records" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "fields" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rejected_changes" ("change_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "fields" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "existing_id" TEXT NULL, "rejected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("change_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "uploads" ("sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "failed_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("sha256"));
